approvers: Main contractor or developer, who set protection in the subcontract package; owner of the firm
reason: We don't buy this today and it would be a new budget line. Film and tape cost next to nothing, and the main contractor decides what protection we provide and who pays, so I can't just add €19/m² myself.
objection: Why pay about €19/m² when film and tape cost almost nothing, with no Maltese reference job and nobody in the subcontract package asking for it?
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape on the glazing and frames, and deal with snagging at handover as we do now.
would_change_my_mind: The main contractor or developer specifying it as a separate paid line in the subcontract package, plus a local reference job showing it saved more in damage than it cost.
